name: Single-slit first dark fringe
meaning: A slit of width a (m) spreads a wave of wavelength lambda (m) so that the first dark fringe is at angle theta; spreading is about lambda/a radians.

name: Double-slit / grating bright fringes
meaning: Bright fringes appear where the path difference d sin(theta) between neighboring slits (spacing d, in m) equals a whole number m of wavelengths.

name: Double-slit fringe spacing (small angles)
meaning: Distance between neighboring bright fringes on a screen a distance L away (all lengths in m).

name: de Broglie wavelength
meaning: Wavelength of a particle with momentum p (kg·m/s); h = 6.626e-34 J·s.

name: Momentum of a slow particle
meaning: Momentum (kg·m/s) of a particle of mass m (kg) and kinetic energy K (J), valid when K is much less than its rest energy.

name: Rayleigh criterion (circular aperture)
meaning: Smallest resolvable angle (radians) for an eye, camera, or telescope of aperture diameter D (m).

name: Microscope (Abbe) diffraction limit
meaning: Smallest resolvable separation (m) for a microscope objective of numerical aperture NA; about 200 nm for visible light.

name: Rayleigh scattering scaling
meaning: For particles much smaller than the wavelength, scattering grows steeply with size d and falls steeply with wavelength; per unit area it goes as (d/lambda)^4.
